name: Camera Avoidance & Blind Spot Mapping
description: Physical security camera systems almost always have blind spots — angles, distances, or occlusions that limit their coverage. Mapping these during recon using aerial photography and perimeter surveys allows route planning that minimizes camera exposure. Understanding camera types (PTZ vs. fixed, analog vs. IP), field of view, and mounting height informs how much movement is safe and at what distances. Recon footage from a body-worn camera is ideal for post-survey blind spot analysis.

blue.det: Behavioral analytics flagging movement patterns avoiding camera coverage; individual traversing unusual paths through facility.
blue.cm: Eliminate camera blind spots through overlapping coverage design; use PTZ cameras for dynamic coverage; motion-triggered lighting in blind spots; regular camera coverage audits.
